prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1356
Claimant:
Rhonda Cole
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2-23-23
Claim received by phone from the claimant, who reports a low-speed collision while backing out of a space in a
parking lot. The claimant is not represented by counsel and is handling the matter directly.
3-20-23
Reviewed the policy file and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and coverage was in force at the time of the
loss. No prior claims or gaps in coverage appear on the record.
3-24-23
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the incident and notes the reporting
officer's observations at the scene.
4-1-23
Contacted the other driver, who confirms the accident happened as the claimant described it. Witness statements
received so far are consistent with that account.
4-8-23
Received photographs of both vehicles from the scene. Damage to the rear bumper and tailgate of the claimant's
vehicle lines up well with the impact described.
4-13-23
Requested maintenance and prior repair history for the vehicle. No earlier damage to the same areas is known, and
nothing in the records suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
4-19-23
Claimant reported neck pain and stiffness the day after the collision and provided initial medical records. The kind and
force of the impact are a reasonable match for the reported injury.
5-11-23
Reviewed prior medical records. The claimant was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that
earlier condition adds to the current complaints, so it will be factored into the evaluation.
6-15-23
Claimant later supplied a few additional details about the seating position and the moment of impact. These are minor
and do not change the core account, which has stayed consistent from the first report.
7-5-23
Treatment followed a usual course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits. Symptoms have been tapering as the
claimant improves, and the most recent treatment notes reflect steady progress.
9-29-23
Based on the documented damage, witness and police confirmation, medical course, and the claimant's consistent
account, the file is ready for evaluation. The prior body-area history will be noted in the injury assessment.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
